channel.title: PortWatch
channel.description: A live tracker for open-source compatibility layers, emulators and recompilation projects. It shows real progress, how fast each one is gaining stars, release dates, and which fork is which, so hype can be checked against what has actually shipped. Snapshot 2026-10-15.
